explanation: Requested a 5-point scan of cos(theta*) from -1 to +1 (i.e. -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1) at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg for the eta channel. Preflight check flagged the two endpoint values (cos_theta = -1 and +1) as FAIL because the code cannot evaluate exactly at the angular poles. Applied the tool's validated fix -- clamped these to +/-0.999 -- and regenerated; all 5 points then passed preflight. Input file was generated with the channel default beam energy of 6.53 GeV (CLAS12 RG-K, the validated eta campaign) and vcut = 0.166 GeV^2, using the full O(alpha) radiative correction mode. Note: other CLAS12 beam energies (10.6 GeV RG-A, 10.2 GeV RG-B) are also valid and give different radiative corrections; state 6.53 GeV when reporting these results.
